summary: Added a `share` maths kind so money-scale Shorts can split a fortune among people or count the years a salary takes to reach a billion, with figures checked by the number check. All five experiments still wait for data.
why: Nothing matured (all five experiments short of their per-arm minimum) and experiments are at the cap of 5, so no new A/B. Research's maths-divide-and-scale (template, high confidence, effort S) unblocks a feed topic and stops writers bending fee_take.

findings.title: 27 videos have 48 h data
findings.detail: quiet-bed 1 of 4 long per arm, hook-voice-matches-frame 3 of 8, title-names-the-moment 1 of 8, chart-gap-fill 0 of 4, loop-picture-matches-hook 0 of 8: all wait.

findings.title: Music, length and hooks
findings.detail: cinematic 30.2x median 48 h views (n=4, 85.8% viewed); 25-29 s Shorts 16.4x (n=4, 81.4%); myth hooks 0.32x (n=5, 24.5%); forest palette 0.30x (n=4, 19.9%).

findings.title: Formats
findings.detail: Only rule_change has 3+ Shorts (n=3, 42.9% viewed): not under the median, nothing retired.
